record.one_liner: Brex is a spend platform combining corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay/payments for businesses.
record.auth_notes: Customer-side: user token (created in dashboard Developer settings, scoped, sent as Bearer; expires after 90 days without use). Third-party/partner apps: OAuth2 authorization code grant (client credentials grant for the onboarding/referrals API), but client ID/secret and scopes are issued by Brex developer support, not self-serve. The MCP server also supports OAuth (browser login) and the Bearer API token.
record.access_notes: An account admin or card admin of an existing Brex company accepts the Developer API agreement and creates a user token in dashboard Developer settings. This is self-serve for a customer's own account. It requires being a Brex customer; I did not find a pricing tier gate or a free sandbox. Brex only offers a production server (api.brex.com). Multi-tenant OAuth for a public integration requires contacting Brex developer support for a client ID/secret. Whether a Brex account itself is free to open was not verified.
record.blocker: Requires a Brex customer account with an admin to accept the developer agreement; no sandbox (production only); OAuth for multi-user third-party apps requires Brex-issued client credentials via support; tokens expire after 90 days of inactivity; the official MCP is Beta.

evidence.auth: https://developer.brex.com/docs/authentication/ (user token as Bearer; admin creates in Developer settings; production-only server). https://developer.brex.com/guides/partner_authentication (OAuth2 auth code + client credentials; client ID/secret from developer support).
evidence.access: https://developer.brex.com/docs/authentication/ (account/card admin, accept developer API agreement, Create Token).
evidence.api: https://developer.brex.com (REST, OpenAPI; Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel, Webhooks).
evidence.mcp: https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp (hosted at api.brex.com/mcp, Beta, OAuth or API key, 44 tools; approvals and card management not available).
